title: CONNECT-IP HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 Extended CONNECT Policy Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9484 HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 CONNECT-IP Extended CONNECT request and response policy.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectIp` mirrors the existing CONNECT-UDP request-policy shape for RFC 9484: it builds Extended CONNECT request headers, exposes the server Extended CONNECT setting obligation, validates CONNECT and `connect-ip` pseudo-headers, validates proxy authority/scheme/path against URI Template expansion, enforces Capsule-Protocol no-content semantics, validates 2xx successful responses, and maps malformed or failed proxying attempts to an abort decision.
data_and_state_considerations: The helper is stateless header/status policy. It does not own HTTP SETTINGS transport exchange or live tunnel I/O.
edge_cases_and_constraints: A request with the wrong Extended CONNECT protocol token is malformed.
Successful responses with HTTP content fields are rejected before proxying proceeds.
risks: HTTP/2 adapter wiring remains outside this HTTP/3 helper surface.
Capsule payload handling and IP packet forwarding remain separate RFC 9484 slices.
